abacus_budget: Fixed total rings, at most nine per place, extremize position weights.
unbounded_naturals: Construct a successor to refute a largest natural number.
delete_one_digit: Delete one position while preserving all other order.
digit_inequality: Find all digits satisfying strict comparison of whole numerals.
global_card_assignment: Shared finite card inventory couples simultaneous comparisons.
column_multi_blank: Interdependent missing columns including carry or exchange.
minimum_pair_swaps: Shortest sequence of arbitrary pair swaps to a specified order.
insert_single_plus: Choose a cut in an ordered digit string; no reordering.
prefix_difference: Prepending a fixed place contribution leaves an invariant difference.
infer_rounding_place: Infer every possible rounding place from input and output.
unit_fraction_decomposition: Decompose into two distinct positive unit fractions; prove completeness.
discrete_fraction_integrality: A fraction of an indivisible finite count must be integral.
finite_parameter_extrema: Finite parameter domain and nonzero denominator, then compare values.
structural_product_cancel: Identify matching factors before multiplying; do not cancel summands.
reverse_algorithm_error: Recover operand from an explicitly supplied incorrect partial-product rule.
conjunctive_numeral_filter: Conjunction of class, position and parity conditions, not one filter.
